title: Electric 20 Concrete Pump Catalogue Row
seoTitle: Electric 20 Concrete Pump | Pinjin 22 kW 8–10 m³/h Xingtai
description: Electric 20 is a Xingtai electric trailer pump: 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, 120 m / 40 m, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm, 900 kg. Rated voltage is not printed. It is not Electric 30 and not Electric 15.

answerBlock.what: Electric 20 Concrete Pump is an electric trailer concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, 120 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, delivery pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm, 900 kg. Rated voltage is not printed on this page. It is not Electric 15 and not Electric 30.
answerBlock.who: Grid sites matched to 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, 80 mm pipe and 1–2 cm stone on a 900 kg trailer.
factors: 22 kW / 80 mm / 900 kg versus Electric 15 at 15 kW / 100–125 mm / 450 kg, both 8–10 m³/h
Electric 30 is 30 kW / 12–15 m³/h / 20 MPa / 1200 kg
Voltage and frequency are not on the Electric 20 sheet
An Alibaba 10–20 m³/h title does not replace 8–10 m³/h

faqs.question: Does Electric 20 print 380 V or 50 Hz?
faqs.answer: No. Electric 20 prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, 120 m / 40 m, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm and 900 kg. Rated voltage is printed on B500S-83D (380 V), not on this page. Send the site voltage with the inquiry.

faqs.question: Is Electric 20 the Alibaba 10–20 m³/h new-arrival pump?
faqs.answer: No. A March 2025 Alibaba listing title reads 10 m³/h–20 m³/h. Electric 20 prints 8–10 m³/h. Use the Xingtai cell.
